change.oneDeclaredChange: more hidden units: H = 48 instead of 24. Everything else is ra-lm-h/1's: tanh, 10 epochs, lr 0.1, l2 0.0001, seed 1, interruptText true, the same task texts (TF-IDF into 24 buckets), the same 14 scene features, the same label masks, the same parameter head, the same synthetic demonstrations and task balance, the three station tasks in training.
change.why: ra-lm-h trails bc on AMR base, 0.717 vs 0.817 on 7181–7240 (−0.100 [−0.247, 0.052], arena.json retest7.comparisons.amr). The hidden layer is what moved ra-lm on the gaps (+0.133 [0.028, 0.235]); this asks whether more of it closes AMR.
change.notChosen: the clone's per-robot order / holder features (COLEARN amr-robots): they need RA_LM_D ≥ 19, which changes the scene input for every task and every model that shares the feature code; more hidden units changes one number in one model
change.hyperparameters: H 48 is the declared value. It may be changed only after runs on development seeds 1–20 (gym) and only by an amendment to this file committed before the held-out run, saying what was tried and what each scored on development seeds.

secondary: ra-lm-h48 minus ra-lm-h on rb-amr-fleet-routing (the effect of the change, same seeds)
ra-lm-h minus bc on rb-amr-fleet-routing and on rb-port-gantry (the round-7 gaps, fresh seeds)
reactive minus bc on the three hard variants, each and pooled (180)
comparisons.noClaim: no claim is made from a difference whose interval spans 0; a promotion only through the gate above
